root_cause.text: Bluetooth socket destructors for HCI, ISO, L2CAP, and SCO protocols failed to purge the sk_error_queue, which can accumulate SKBs when TX timestamping (SO_TIMESTAMPING) is enabled, leading to memory leaks if the queue is never consumed by userspace or if the controller is removed unexpectedly.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb_queue_purge(&sk->sk_error_queue)` to the destructors of `hci_sock_destruct`, `iso_sock_destruct`, `l2cap_sock_destruct`, and `sco_sock_destruct`, while the existing code already purged `sk_receive_queue` and `sk_write_queue` but omitted `sk_error_queue`. The CVE description states: "When TX timestamping is enabled via SO_TIMESTAMPING, SKBs may be queued into sk_error_queue and will stay there until consumed… these SKBs will leak." The commit message also references the fix as addressing the leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Purge the error queue during HCI socket destruction to prevent memory leak of queued error skbs.
intent_record.what: Added skb_queue_purge call for the error queue (sk->sk_error_queue) in the hci_sock_destruct function.
intent_record.how: When a Bluetooth HCI socket is destroyed, the error queue is now also purged, ensuring that any queued error skbs are freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add cleanup of the error queue in ISO socket destructor to prevent memory leaks.
intent_record.what: Added a call to skb_queue_purge for the error queue (sk_error_queue) in the iso_sock_destruct function.
intent_record.how: During socket destruction, the error queue is now also purged, ensuring that any pending error skbs are freed, preventing memory leaks and ensuring full cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Purge the socket error queue in l2cap_sock_destruct to prevent memory leaks when the socket is destroyed.
intent_record.what: Added skb_queue_purge(&sk->sk_error_queue) to l2cap_sock_destruct after purging receive and write queues.
intent_record.how: Previously, only receive and write queues were cleared on socket destruction. Now the error queue is also purged, freeing any pending error skbs and preventing memory leaks.

intent_record.intent_summary: In the SCO socket destructor, purge the error queue to prevent memory leaks from pending error skbs.
intent_record.what: Added a call to skb_queue_purge on sk->sk_error_queue in the sco_sock_destruct function, after existing purges of receive and write queues.
intent_record.how: During socket destruction, the error queue is now emptied, freeing any skbs that were pending there, preventing memory leaks.

consistency_review.core_intent: Purge the socket error queue in various Bluetooth socket destructors (HCI, ISO, L2CAP, SCO) to prevent memory leaks.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly address the vulnerability by purging the sk_error_queue in Bluetooth socket destructors for HCI, ISO, L2CAP, and SCO, preventing memory leaks.

candidates.rationale: The HCI socket destructor purges receive and write queues but fails to purge the error queue (sk_error_queue), allowing error skbs to leak.
The ISO socket destructor purges receive and write queues but fails to purge the error queue, causing memory leak of error skbs.
The L2CAP socket destructor purges receive and write queues but fails to purge the error queue, leading to memory leak.
The SCO socket destructor purges receive and write queues but fails to purge the error queue, causing memory leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: The HCI socket destructor purges the write queue but fails to purge the sk_error_queue, which can accumulate SKBs from TX timestamping and lead to a memory leak when the socket is destroyed.
The ISO socket destructor purges the write queue but fails to purge the sk_error_queue, causing queued error SKBs to leak if the socket is destroyed without consuming the error queue.
The L2CAP socket destructor purges the write queue but does not purge the sk_error_queue, resulting in a memory leak of error SKBs when the socket is destroyed.
The SCO socket destructor purges the write queue but omits cleanup of the sk_error_queue, leading to a memory leak if error SKBs are pending at destruction time.
